t.name: Six Ridge Primitive Trail
t.description: Primitive poorly maintained way trail that connects the North Fork Skokomish Trail to the Wynoochee Pass area.

t.name: Graves Creek Primitive Trail
t.description: This primitive and poorly maintained tral connects the Quinault River trail with the South Fork Skokomish and Six Ridge Trails.

t.name: South Fork Skokomish River Trail
t.description: This trail leads from the park boundary up and over Sundown Pass to connect with the Sundown Lake Trail.

t.name: South Fork Skokomish River Trail 873
t.description: This trail wanders through old growth forest and crosses the South Fork Skokomish River and other streamss befoe climbing up the national park boundary.

t.name: Wynoochee Pass Trail #874
t.description: This short trail starts at the Wynoochee Pass Trailhead and travels through heavy forest to the national park boundary.

t.name: Wynoochee Pass Trail
t.description: Thre trail runs form the park boundary over Wynoochee Pass and down to connect with the Graves Creek and Sundown Lake Trails.

t.name: Sundown Lake Trail
t.description: This trail connects Lake Sundown to the Wynoochee Pass, South Fork Skokomish River, and Graves Creek Trails.

t.name: East Fork Quinault River Trail
t.description: a long trail leading up the valley of the Quinault River to Enchanted Valley and the alpine slopes of Anderson Pass.
